newsitem.title: IRAQ: Change of US president makes no difference - Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Change of US president makes no difference - Iraq.

text.p: An Iraqi newspaper on Tuesday attacked the United States, saying the election of a new president will make no difference because Washington's policy will remain the same.

"The world will see today (Tuesday) the election of a new U.S. president and at the same time it will witness similar U.S. policy (in the world) based on hegemony and anarchy using its military might to serve its own policy to which only Iraq has said 'No'," the official al-Iraq newspaper said.
"The winner of the elections is the one who has pleased the Zionist entity (Israel)," it added in a commentary.
The newspaper, in a front page editorial, also condemned the U.S. policy in the Middle East, saying that Washington had "vicious interests" in Iraq, the Gulf and other Arab countries.

"At a time the United States maintains agreements and treaties with several Arab regimes, it behaves with these states without caring about their rights, interests and dignity," said the editorial written by former information under-secretary Noori al-Marsoomi.
